messages:
Anya: Heads-up — Acme partner ingest is spiking with late-arrival bursts. Current idempotency uses monotonic seq but devices reboot and reset seq. Thinking about a 'watermark_epoch' + rollback window to handle out-of-order/duplicate replays. Proposal below.

Jordan: Sketch? curious how this won't create double-counts in billing.

Anya: Short sketch: store per-partner tuple (epoch, highest_seq_committed). Incoming event has header epoch+seq+watermark. If epoch==stored_epoch -> dedupe by seq as today. If epoch>stored_epoch -> allow accepting seqs up to a configurable rollback_window (time OR seq gap) and mark rolled-back ranges as tombstoned. After crossing rollback threshold, require explicit commit handshake from partner.

Matt: Splitting raw-ingest vs ledger-commit sounds right. Raw can accept rollback-windows; only ledger-committed events drive billing. That way reconciliation won't accidentally issue credits twice.

Lia: Concern: rollback may affect entitlements/credits already shown to customer. We should never remove a committed billing row without manual review or a documented correction flow. For example: rollback applies only to pre-commit ingestion stage.

Riley: +1 on splitting topics. We can implement a two-topic flow: `partner.raw-ingest` and `partner.committed-usage`. Consumer makes a commit call after validations.

MarketplaceBot: created ticket MP-1123: "ingest-watermark-epoch-rollback" assigned to @matt, priority P2. Link: https://issues.redwood.ai/MP-1123

Anya: Pseudo header example:
```
{
  "partner": "acme",
  "epoch": 17,
  "seq": 92345,
  "watermark": "2026-02-20T18:12:00Z"
}
```
Logic notes:
- if epoch == stored_epoch -> dedupe by seq set
- if epoch > stored_epoch -> accept seq <= (max_rollback_seq OR watermark within rollback_window) and write tombstones for rolled-back seqs
- otherwise drop or ask partner to reingest with commit handshake

Jordan: How to size `max_rollback_seq` or `rollback_window`? 10k events or 1h by default? Need telemetry.

Matt: I propose defaults: 1 hour OR 50k events, configurable per partner. We'll capture metrics: rollback_count, rollback_bytes, tombstone_rate.

Lia: Also update reconciliation playbook: add steps for tombstone audit, manual crediting flow, legal notification if credits change. I'll draft playbook language.

Riley: I'll add schema change to partner onboarding docs and flag for SI partners: we need them to implement the commit handshake.

Anya: Implementation plan: Matt prototypes consumer changes in go-ingest; Riley prepares schema doc; Lia updates playbook; Jordan helps define telemetry. Quick sync tomorrow 30m if everyone can. Reply with :+1: if you can.

Jordan: +1
Matt: +1
Lia: +1
Riley: +1
MarketplaceBot: Reminder scheduled: MP-sync 2026-02-21 10:00 PT for ticket MP-1123

Anya: Thanks — will create PRs and link them here. If anyone sees partner contract issues (credits reversal), @Lia please escalate to legal.

Jordan: One more: add a test harness that can simulate epoch rollbacks and validate aggregator idempotency. I can help build that.

Matt: I'll start the prototype branch `feat/epoch-rollback` and post PR link here when ready.

Anya: Cool. End of thread.
